note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; where the focus participant appears (in the room or in a window) is the single supplied difference and carries no legal meaning, no validity, no preference and no outcome.
coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule 2026-09-26 (LAW-0687/0689–0692; AUTHORING item 20): long-labels-stress text lengths are capped after trying the fallbacks (centre column, strip in one row or a 2×2 grid, quarter-turned scenes, shallower corridor, only used chairs drawn, labels beside windows). Measured in 1:1 with the full-length texts (changed fact 107 chars, neutral note 110, key 83, four shared facts, scenario labels 40–47, captions 62–70): best composition had people 41.9 px at 18 px text (floor 60 px). With these capped texts: people 61.7 px at 18 px in 1:1, 64+ px in 16:9 and 9:16. Every stress field stays strictly longer than the baseline and the counts stay equal to the baseline.
